decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered T2770-030 C, -031 C, -032 C, -035 C, -038 C, -039 C, -044, -045, -046, -047, -050 B, -060 B, -061 B, -160, -161, -162, -163, -164, -165, -166, -167, -168, -169 received on 21st October 2010 and drawings numbered Notwithstanding the staff toilet QHN/01/V C, QHN/02/V C, QHN/03/SC B, QHN/04/SG B, DS-210 received on 22nd October 2010 and numbered T2770-033 D, -034 D, -036 D, -037 D, -039 D, -062 C, -063, -064, -065 received on 9th December 2010 submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and in accordance with the conditions below, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the works, details of how the suspended ceiling would join to the external glazed windows on the northwest and southeast elevations shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, the partition at ground floor level between the staff area and reception area and the partition between Play room 4 and Play room 7 at first floor level, shall be glazed.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings submitted, the partitions between Play room 4 and Playroom 7 and the panels at ground and first floor levels besides the edge of the stairs and doorways shall contain full length glazed partitions only.

Condition : 6 - No further compartmentation or additional materials and no alternative connections or junctions other than those shown on the approved drawings detailed under condition 2 shall be provided unless agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Internal and external works at ground and first floor levels, associated with fitting out the interior
